abilities.notes: Book-dispersion lens added 2026-08-02. Passes lose counterfactually when books disagree by 0.25pp+; mechanism candidate: best-price EV is inflated by soft-book outliers when books disagree, honest when they agree. Pass pool: no CLV, paper-mode ceiling per SKILL.md. 2026-08-04 (fresh data through 08-03): cleared the bar AGAIN on grown N (314 -> 347 settled, t strengthened -2.2 -> -2.29) — consecutive_hits=2. Promotion still blocked: bonferroni_significant=false in both runs (118/120 cells), and the 08-02->08-04 gap is 2 days, so treat next Monday's scheduled run as the true consecutive-weekly test. Related cells moved AGAINST the story on fresh data, keep honest: very-wide (0.6pp+) softened below the bar (28-35, -19.2%, t=-1.66), and the tight-dispersion flip-side hypothesis weakened (was 105-72 +10.3% t=1.46; now 112-82 +7.0% t=1.04 — the new week went 7-10). Bet-pool tension from the 08-04 stale-run reconcile also stands: very-wide-dispersion BETS were the engine's best segment (10-3, +41.8%, n=13), so the framing stays pass-side EV inflation, never blanket dispersion suppression.

evidence.note: Data refreshed through 08-03 (Supabase pull). Very-wide corroborating cell softened below the bar this run (t=-1.66).

abilities.notes: Totals tilt lens added 2026-08-02 (tilt provenance only stored since the 2026-07 commit, so the sample is recent-games-only by construction). Passed totals where the model tilted mildly OVER the market mean went 16-30 counterfactually — consistent with the totals model's known historical over-bias (tilt bug fixed 2026-07-02): a mild over-tilt that still fails the EV bar looks like residual over-lean, and the engine is right to pass. Small N (46 settled), pass pool (no CLV, paper-mode ceiling), not Bonferroni-significant. If it persists, likelier a validation/monitoring story than a change.
